fields.review_notes: All ACs verified against persisted .agents/agents/*.agent.md files, not live re-count. AC1/AC2: regression-probe log shows after=~28 tools (~3.4k derived tokens), well under the 60-tool/10k-token gates; the implementer-reported live re-spawn of 44 tools (session template-cache artifact) is still <60 and does not breach either gate -- judged a measurement-precision artifact, not an AC1/AC2 failure. AC3: all 16 .agents/agents/*.agent.md templates carry an '## MCP Tool Grant' section; every wildcard grant has a one-line role justification (spot-checked audit/commit/default/explore/handoff/implement/interview/iteration/orchestrator/research/roast/spec/testing/ticket-refinement/transcription -- 16/16). AC4: tool-grant-regression-probe.prompt.md documents tool_search as unavailable-with-reason (VS Code client-level mechanism, not repo-controlled). AC5: same prompt file's Measurement Log table records before/after tool counts with consistent method. Recommended: done. Spec ec3b13f1 remains draft (separate entity, not gating this ticket).
